name: iam:AttachUserPolicy
description: A principal with iam:AttachUserPolicy can attach managed policies to any user they have this permission on. This is frequently exploited for self-escalation by attaching the AdministratorAccess managed policy to the caller's own user.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target user must be in Resource section; for self-escalation, must have permission on own user

admin: A managed IAM policy with elevated privileges must exist in the account
Principal must be a user (not a role)
lateral: A managed IAM policy with elevated privileges must exist in the account
Principal must be a user (not a role)

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the managed policy to attach (defaults to AdministratorAccess)

options.name: VERIFY
options.description: Verify escalation by calling iam:ListUsers after (true/false)
